description: This file defines various HTTP request handler functions for managing lessons in an educational or training web application. It includes functions for listing lessons, retrieving specific lessons, updating user progress, and CRUD operations (create, update, delete) for lessons, with some validation schemas. It imports modules from 'express', Prisma ORM utils, authentication middleware, and 'zod' for schema validation.

methods.description: Fetches a specific lesson by its id, including its modules ordered by 'order'.

methods.description: Updates or creates a user's progress record for a lesson, validating input with zod schema.
